expectations.text: Uses reveal.js as the presentation framework
expectations.evidence: Found reveal.js references: CDN links to reveal.js@5 (reveal.css, white.css theme, reveal.js script)

expectations.text: Contains a timeline with at least 3 historical dates/years
Has at least one discussion slide prompting student discussion
expectations.evidence: Found 3 slides containing 'Diskutera' - two dedicated discussion slides (slides 4 and 8) with red background and timed discussion prompts

expectations.text: Contains a source criticism exercise with a historical quote
expectations.evidence: Slide 9 has a blockquote with a historical quote about women's suffrage (ca 1912 riksdag debate), followed by source-critical questions (Vem? När? Syfte?). Slide 10 continues with source analysis (Tendens, Tidsanda, Maktperspektiv)

expectations.text: No slide has more than 3 bullet points in a list
expectations.evidence: Maximum bullet points in any single list: 3. All ul/ol elements across all sections have 3 or fewer direct li children

expectations.text: At least half of slide titles are phrased as questions
expectations.evidence: 8/10 h2 titles are questions (80%). Questions include 'Vem fick bestämma i Sverige - och vem fick inte?', 'Hur styrdes Sverige före demokratin?', etc. Only 2 non-questions: 'Diskutera (2 min)' x2

expectations.text: Uses reveal.js fragments for progressive disclosure
expectations.evidence: Found 21 elements with class='fragment' across multiple slides, including timeline items, comparison columns, list items, and stat elements

expectations.text: Speaker notes present on at least half of content slides
expectations.evidence: Found 11 <aside class="notes"> elements across 11 sections (100% coverage). Every slide has speaker notes

expectations.text: Single HTML file with no local file dependencies
expectations.evidence: All resources loaded from CDNs (jsdelivr for reveal.js, Google Fonts) or inline. No relative path references found

expectations.text: Base font size is at least 24px for projector readability
